_README: Single source of every number in docs/TermMap_writeup.pdf and in the README results block. Edit values here, then run: python scripts/make_pdf.py . Any value equal to the string PENDING is rendered with a yellow PENDING marker. 'status' = interim | final. Filled from the Kaggle run (reports/metrics.json, metrics.md, ablations.md, dense_benchmark.md, error_analysis_*.md, benchmark.json, hard_cases.json, pytest.xml, determinism.json).

validation.note: point values are 3-seed means; CIs and n are for the primary seed (ICD 0.6085, SNOMED 0.5672)

final_test.note: primary seed, scored once with the frozen configuration before the refit; 2-seed means ICD 0.643, SNOMED 0.601; headline CI [0.550, 0.637]; gap to 95% target 0.351

results.final_refit: models/final.pkl refit on train+val+test with the frozen configuration (so the final model has seen the test split; the test numbers above come from the pre-refit model)

earlier_cpu_only.note: CPU-only run without the four dense encoders; code-disjoint row counts differ, so not exactly like-for-like

recall.recall_label_note: dense_benchmark.md reports union R@100 and R@300 (no @200). The interim '@200' figures match R@300 and are kept under the old keys only for script compatibility: label them @300 in the PDF.
recall.retrieval_miss_vs_rank_miss: validation ICD 40 retrieval / 135 rank (of 175 errors); SNOMED 44 / 188 (of 232). Final test ICD 36 / 91; SNOMED 25 / 136

slices_val_icd.weak_chapters: F 0.36 (n=11); M, E and I about 0.60 to 0.64

calibration.coverage_at_conf_0.7: ICD: 36% of rows at 0.87 accuracy; SNOMED: 30% of rows at 0.93 accuracy (validation)

failure_modes_counts: Validation ICD (175 errors): FM1 71; FM2 84; FM3 42; FM5 74; FM6 15. SNOMED (232 errors): FM1 106; FM2 118; FM5 143; FM6 31. FM4 (407 pairs with both labels): both right 185, ICD right only 66, SNOMED right only 74, both wrong 82. FM7: 0 dictionary/version mismatches. Counts overlap (one error can touch several modes).

engineering.cpu_terms_per_second: 1.48 (full model with four dense encoders, 4 CPU cores, batch of 576); about 6 in the earlier CPU-only run without dense encoders
engineering.cpu_median_latency_s: 6.19 single term (p95 8.71) with dense encoders; 0.34 in the earlier no-dense run
engineering.cpu_peak_ram: about 25.3 GB with dense encoders; about 5.5 GB in the earlier no-dense run
engineering.gpu_terms_per_second: not measured (benchmark.json: GPU mode NOT RUN)
engineering.per_term_model_calls: no cross-encoder or LLM calls; 5 dense query encodings per term
engineering.determinism: NOT confirmed: the latest two-run check gave different output hashes (MISMATCH, CPU only). An earlier check on the no-dense model matched. Cause not yet investigated
engineering.tests: 36 of 42 passed; the 6 failures are hard-case assertions (essential HTN, MS x2, RA x2, PID disc), not crashes
